rationale: Correct the existing Infinigen ownership period in place rather than adding the duplicate ArcLight owner proposed by the census queue. Production and evaluated seed already map census manager ArcLight Capital to canonical ArcLight Capital Partners. Current primary evidence identifies Infinigen as wholly owned by an ArcLight-managed fund, while ArcLight identifies Infinigen as a current ArcLight Fund VII portfolio company. Link the existing period to the canonical ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII, L.P. record, record the 100% platform-level stake, retain the 2021 investment year and CLOSED_ACTIVE state, add the legal LLC alias and current website, and refresh direct identity and ownership evidence. Helios Alternative Energy's retained minority interest is limited to the Oriana and Horizon operating-asset portfolio and is not added as a co-owner of the Infinigen platform. No Infinigen-specific sale or pending exit was identified through August 13, 2026; DigitalBridge's conditional agreement to acquire ArcLight is a manager-level transaction rather than a transfer of Infinigen or Fund VII's stake.

beforeImage.name: Infinigen Renewables
beforeImage.description: Infinigen Renewables is a solar and storage platform focused on Puerto Rico. The business serves the island's power market through an asset-heavy model combining operating renewable assets, new development, and storage integration. ArcLight stated at launch that the platform included what it described as the largest solar and storage operating fleet in Puerto Rico and a controlled pipeline approaching 1 GW of additional projects. Later public disclosures included the acquisition of Sonnedix's Puerto Rico solar portfolio, extending the platform's operating base. ArcLight launched Infinigen in December 2021 with a $400 million capital commitment through ArcLight Energy Partners Fund VII, while public sources do not disclose the detailed ownership percentages.

milestones.event: ArcLight described Infinigen as the largest solar and storage operating platform in Puerto Rico at launch.

afterImage.name: Infinigen Renewables
afterImage.description: Infinigen Renewables is a San Juan, Puerto Rico-based independent power producer that owns, develops and operates utility-scale and commercial-and-industrial solar and battery-storage infrastructure. Its operating portfolio includes the 73.2 MW Horizon and Oriana solar plants, while Yabucoa adds a 32.1 MW solar project paired with 15 MW of storage and its development pipeline exceeds 1 GW. ArcLight launched the platform in 2021 with a $400 million capital commitment; current ArcLight and company materials identify Infinigen as an unrealized Fund VII portfolio company and a wholly owned subsidiary of an ArcLight-managed fund. No Infinigen-specific sale or pending exit was identified through August 13, 2026.
